sanskrit: devā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaro 'po dattodadhiṃ bhinta | divas pṛthivyā uror antarikṣād asmai kṣatrāyānena brahmaṇābhyaḥ prajābhya ābhya oṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā ||
english: O gods, O Maruts born of Pṛśni, grant the waters, cleave the deep reservoir — from broad heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere — for this sovereignty, for the Brahmins through this sacred word, for the offspring, for these, for the herbs: svāhā!

sanskrit: devā agna indra sūrya- -apaḥ (…) ||
english: O gods — Agni, Indra, Sūrya — grant the waters, cleave the deep reservoir [from broad heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere — for this sovereignty, for the Brahmins through this sacred word, for the offspring, for these, for the herbs: svāhā!]

sanskrit: devāḥ sayujo mitra varuṇāryamann apaḥ (…) ||
english: O gods yoked together — Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryaman — grant the waters [cleave the deep reservoir, from broad heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere — for this sovereignty, for the Brahmins through this sacred word, for the offspring, for these, for the herbs: svāhā!]

sanskrit: devāḥ pitaro 'vamā āyavaḥ krāvya- -apaḥ (…) ||
english: O gods, O Fathers, the near descendants of Āyu who consume the raw offering — grant the waters [cleave the deep reservoir, from broad heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere — for this sovereignty, for the Brahmins through this sacred word, for the offspring, for these, for the herbs: svāhā!]

sanskrit: devāpsuṣado 'pāṃ napāt tanūnapān narāśaṃsa- -apo dattodadhiṃ bhinta | (…) ||
english: O gods who dwell in the waters — Apāṃ Napāt, Tanūnapāt, Narāśaṃsa — grant the waters, cleave the deep reservoir [from broad heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere — for this sovereignty, for the Brahmins through this sacred word, for the offspring, for these, for the herbs: svāhā!]

sanskrit: deva bṛhaspate 'po dhehy udadhiṃ bhindhi | (…) ||
english: O god Bṛhaspati, set forth the waters, cleave the ocean [from broad heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere — for this sovereignty, for the Brahmins through this sacred word, for the offspring, for these, for the herbs: svāhā!]

sanskrit: deva prajāpate 'po dhehy udadhiṃ bhindhi | (…) ||
english: O god Prajāpati, set forth the waters, cleave the ocean [from broad heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere — for this sovereignty, for the Brahmins through this sacred word, for the offspring, for these, for the herbs: svāhā!]

sanskrit: deva parameṣṭhinn apo dhehy udadhiṃ bhindhi | divas pṛthivyā uror antarikṣād asmai kṣatrāyānena brahmaṇābhyaḥ prajābhya ābhya oṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā ||
english: O god Parameṣṭhin, set forth the waters, cleave the ocean — from broad heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere — for this sovereignty, for the Brahmins through this sacred word, for the offspring, for these, for the herbs: svāhā!

sanskrit: prajāpater jāyamānāḥ prajā jātāś ca yā imāḥ | tā asmai prati vedaya cikitvām̐ anu manyatām ||
english: These creatures here that are being born and those already born from Prajāpati — make them known to this one; may the all-knowing approve and consent.

sanskrit: yeṣām īśe paśupatiḥ paśūnāṃ catuṣpadām uta vā ye dvipādaḥ | niṣkrītās te yajñiyā yanti lokaṃ rāyaspoṣāya yajamānaṃ sacantām ||
english: Those beasts — the four-footed ones over whom Paśupati holds sway, or those that are two-footed — once ransomed they go as sacrificial offerings to the sacred realm; may they accompany the sacrificer for the flourishing of wealth.

sanskrit: pramuñcanto bhuvanasya gopā gātuṃ devā yajamānāya dhatta | upākṛtaṃ śaśamānaṃ yad asthāt priyaṃ devānām apy etu pāthaḥ ||
english: As they release it, O guardians of the world, O gods, bestow passage upon the sacrificer; that which stood prepared and laboring — may the dear path of the gods be attained.

sanskrit: ye badhyamānam anu dīdhyānā anvaikṣanta manasā cakṣuṣā ca | agniṣ ṭān agre pra mumukta devaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ ||
english: Those who gazed upon it with contemplation as it was being bound, who watched it with mind and with eye — Agni first released them, the god who is in accord with Prajāpati together with his offspring.

sanskrit: yeṣāṃ prāṇā anvabadhnanta badvaṃ gavāṃ paśūnām uta pūruṣāṇām | indras tān agre pra mumukta devaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ ||
english: Those whose vital breaths were bound in the tether of cattle, of beasts, and of men — Indra first released them, the god who is in accord with Prajāpati together with his offspring.

sanskrit: ya āraṇyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpā ye viśvarūpā utaikarūpāḥ | vāyuṣ ṭān agre pra mumukta devaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ ||
english: The wild forest beasts of all forms, and those of all forms as well as those of a single form — Vāyu first released them, the god who is in accord with Prajāpati together with his offspring.

sanskrit: prajānantaḥ prati gṛhṇantu devāḥ prāṇam aṅgebhyas paryācarantam | dyāṃ gaccha prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ svargaṃ yāhi pathibhiḥ śivebhiḥ ||
english: May the gods, fully knowing, receive the vital breath moving about from limb to limb; go to heaven, stand firm with your bodies, travel to the celestial world by auspicious paths.

sanskrit: samās tvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu saṃvatsara ṛṣayo yāni satyā | saṃ dyumnena dīdihi rocanena viśvā ā bhāhi pradiśaś catasraḥ ||
english: May the years, O Agni, may the seasons strengthen you; may the year and the seers who are truth itself augment you; blaze together with resplendent brightness; shine upon all four quarters.

sanskrit: saṃ cedhyasvāgne pra ca bodhayainam uc ca tiṣṭha mahate saubhagāya | mā te riṣann upasattāro atra brāhmaṇās te yaśasaḥ santu mānye ||
english: Kindle yourself together, O Agni, and awaken him; stand up high for great good fortune; may the worshippers who approach you here not be harmed; may the Brahmins who tend you here be renowned and worthy of honor.

sanskrit: tvām agne vṛṇate brāhmaṇā ime śivo agne prataraṇo na edhi | sapatnahāgne abhimātijid bhava sve kṣaye dīdihy aprayucchan ||
english: These Brahmins choose you, O Agni; be auspicious and propitious to us, O Agni; O Agni, be the slayer of rivals, the conqueror of adversaries; shine in your own abode without faltering.

sanskrit: ihaivāgne adhi dhārayā rayiṃ mā tvā dabhan pūrvacittā nikāriṇaḥ | kṣatram agne suyamam astu tubhyam upasattā vardhatāṃ te aniṣṭṛtaḥ ||
english: Hold fast the wealth here, O Agni; may those who harbor ill intent, the deceivers with prior cunning, not beguile you; may sovereignty well-controlled belong to you, O Agni; may he who approaches you in worship grow, unvanquished.

sanskrit: kṣatreṇāgne svena saṃ rabhasva mitreṇāgne mitradheyaṃ yatasva | sajātānāṃ madhyameṣṭheyam asyā rājñām agne vihavyo dīdihīha ||
english: Seize hold by your own sovereign power, O Agni; strive after friendship's due with the friend, O Agni; may you be chief among kinsmen, the pre-eminent one in their midst; among these kings, O Agni, blaze here as one worthy of invocation.

sanskrit: ati niho 'ti nirṛtīr aty arātīr ati dviṣaḥ | viśvā hy agne duritā tara tvam athāsmabhyaṃ sahavīraṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
english: Beyond the snares, beyond the forces of dissolution, beyond hostilities, beyond those who hate — surpass all adversities, O Agni; then grant us wealth together with heroic offspring.

sanskrit: anādhṛṣyo jātavedā aniṣṭṛto virāḍ agne kṣatrabhir dīdihīha | vyamīvāḥ pramuñcan mānuṣebhyaḥ śivebhir adya pari pāhi no gayaiḥ ||
english: Invincible Jātavedas, unassailed, resplendent sovereign — blaze here, O Agni, with powers of dominion; releasing afflictions from human beings, guard us today on all sides with auspicious homesteads.
